question_record.context: There was a security incident involving suspicious emails sent by a possibly compromised user account as part of a BEC (business email compromise) fraud attempt. One of the associated users was `Nina Park` with the email `Nina Park@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co`. Suspicious emails were sent from this account using the IP address `237.7.81.122`. An alert was triggered based on a previous BEC-related alert.
question_record.question: Shortly after the emails were sent, there was a sign-in from a known malicious IP address. What is the address of this malicious IP?
solution: A potentially compromised user account with AadUserId `e036dee7-fa23-42ef-a019-468c8d3401f1` sent suspicious emails related to a business email compromise (BEC) fraud attempt.
There was a sign-in from a known malicious IP address `170.54.121.63` during or around the time of the suspicious email activity.

18.name: Suspicious emails sent by BEC-related user
18.description: Suspicious emails were sent by a possibly compromised user account related to an ongoing BEC (business email compromise) fraud attempt. This alert was triggered based on a previous BEC-related alert.

23.name: Malicious IP address
23.description: Sign-in from an IP address known to be malicious during or around the time of sign-in

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_Derived_Email' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: Suspicious emails sent by BEC-related user
